ns2:section.sectionText: Performing Arts students who have a sustained interest in Leadership will discuss industry practices, challenges and areas of growth with Krannert Center for the Performing Arts Director Mike Ross and invited industry leaders. Issues will include Aesthetics; Curation; Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Access; Advancement; Culture Building; Strategic Planning; Communications and Marketing. Email Julie Gunn at gunn@illinois.edu to request permission to enroll in this course.
